articles.title: Massimo Lands Order From U.S. Department of Defense and U.S. Army
articles.summary: It appears that the United States military and its associated branches have taken notice of how versatile and relatively inexpensive side-by-sides are (compared to other, larger vehicles regularly in service use, at least), and the orders for UTVs are just piling on . Massimo Group is the latest to be awarded confirmed purchase orders from the U.S. Department of Defense and the U.S. Army.
